text.description_html:
Don-Jo PBDSP-135, Scar Plate Used to Correct Poorly Drilled Installation Holes for Use Under a Deadbolt Collar

The Don-Jo PBDSP-135 fits under the collar of a deadbolt; it is most often used to correct problems associated with poorly drilled installation holes in the door such as misshapen holes and crooked holes. It can also be used to convert a 2-3/8 inch backset to a 2-3/4 inch backset. It has an outer diameter of 3-1/2 inches and an inner diameter of 1-1/2 inches. Choose from satin stainless steel, polished brass, or dark bronze finishes.

Specifications of the Deadbolt Scar Plate:

  • Outer Diameter: 3-1/2"
  • Inner Diameter: 1-1/2"
  • Thickness: 22 gauge, .032"

Sold Individually
